UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Tables', 'joomlaguide-tables', '

In this tour you finish the article Our Services with a table of plans and prices.

You insert a table, fill it, and give it borders, a header row and some space in its cells.

This tour follows the tutorial 3.5 Tables of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 3.5 Tables', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'Open Our Services', '

Click Our Services to open it for editing.

', 3, 'right', '#articleList tbody tr:first-child a[href*="task=article.edit"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'A new section', '
  1. Click at the end of the last line of the article and press Enter.
  2. Set the format to Heading 2, as in the tutorial Headings, and type Plans & Pricing.
  3. Press Enter and type:
    Choose the plan that fits where you are today — you can always move up as you grow.
  4. Press Enter for a new line for the table.

Then click Next.

', 4, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'Insert a table', '
  1. Click ⋯ to show the whole toolbar. Where each icon is depends on the width of your window.
  2. Click the Table icon: it opens a menu.
  3. Hover over its first option, Table. A grid appears.
  4. Move over the grid to select 4 columns and 4 rows, and click.

Then click Next.

', 5, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'Fill in the table', '

Type the cells; press Tab to go to the next cell.

  • Feature, Basic, Standard, Premium
  • Consulting hours, 5/mo, 15/mo, Unlimited
  • Implementation support, Email only, Email + calls, Dedicated manager
  • Support response time, 2 business days, 1 business day, Same Day

Then click Next.

', 6, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'Rows, columns and widths', '

While the cursor is in a cell, a small toolbar appears above the table. With it you add or delete rows and columns; hover over its icons to see what they do.

To change a width, hover over the border between two columns until the cursor changes, then drag it left or right. The far right border sets the width of the table.

Then click Next.

', 7, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'Add cell borders', '

The dashed lines in the editor only help you edit; on the site the cells have no borders yet.

  1. Click in the top left cell and drag to the bottom right cell, to select all cells.
  2. Right-click a selected cell, hover over Cell and click Cell properties.
  3. Click the tab Advanced. Set Border width to 1px and Border style to Solid.
  4. Click Save in that window.

Then click Next.

', 8, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'Make a header row', '
  1. Select the top row: click in its first cell and drag to the right.
  2. Right-click a selected cell, hover over Cell and click Cell properties.
  3. Set Cell type to Header cell and Horizontal align to Center.
  4. Click Save in that window.

The header cells are now bold and centred; header cells also tell screen readers what each column holds. Click Next.

', 9, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'Space in the cells', '
  1. Right-click anywhere in the table and click Table properties.
  2. Type 5px in Cell padding.
  3. Click Save in that window.

Then click Next.

', 10, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'Save your progress', '

Click Save, not Save & Close.

', 11, 'bottom', '.view-article #toolbar-apply .button-apply', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'Look at the table', '

Click Preview and scroll down to the table: it has borders, a centred bold header row and space around the text in its cells.

Close the preview with the × at its top right, then click Next.

', 12, 'bottom', 'body.view-article:has(#system-message-container:not(:empty)) #toolbar-preview .button-preview', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

', 13, 'bottom', '.view-article #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-tables'), 'Well done!', '

Our Services is complete: an opening paragraph with bold and italic, three sections with headings, a bulleted and a nested numbered list, a link and a formatted table.

To show it on your site, add a menu item for it, as in the tutorial Article & Menu Item.

', 14, 'top', '#articleList tbody tr:first-child', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
